title: Jungle Expedition

reviewPolicy.reason: Player visual judgment remains authoritative. Pass 15 makes the weather cycle visibly phase-specific: clear daylight now opens into a crisp blue jungle vista, cloud and fog density accumulate into the established storm, and the sunbreak clears the air without removing the Pass 14 ecology or any prior route, landmark, construction, mission, resident, water, or practical-light systems.

viteProductionBuild.notes: Existing mixed static/dynamic import and large chunk warnings remain; the production bundle completed successfully.

implementedVisualSystems: clear weather reduces the authored cloud field to 0.2 opacity so the bright blue sky, distant jungle depth, and Lost City silhouette read immediately instead of beginning under a permanent gray veil
cloud opacity now follows storm cover continuously from 0.2 to a maximum of 0.68, with a small sunbreak clearance response after the rain
exponential scene fog now changes color and density with the weather: turquoise daylight becomes deep green-gray during the storm and a warm pale jungle haze during the sunbreak
fog density expands from 0.003 in clear daylight to a capped 0.0093 at peak storm, then recedes below the storm value during recovery
ambient mist starts at a restrained 0.1 opacity in clear weather and gathers with rain so stream depth remains readable before the storm arrives
the established 180-second clear, gathering-cloud, storm, rain, weighted lightning, sunray, blue-sky recovery, and long-break cycle remains intact
the Pass 13 practical-light system still intensifies lanterns, torches, halos, and light pools naturally as the weather darkens
the Pass 14 twelve-species ground ecology, animated fauna families, branch habitats, lily pads, lotus buds, ripples, and improved canopy crowns remain intact
all prior route tunnels, five landmark builds, resident work loops, Living Compass mission choreography, and Emerald Zenith finale remain intact

evidence.proves: the ordinary clear-day production framing now presents a bright blue sky, crisp Lost City hierarchy, legible layered canopy, open river corridor, water garden, residents, and foreground ecology together on the narrow-phone workbench surface
